titles.title: The Lord Is Gracious and Compassionate

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
The Lord is gracious and compassionate
Slow to anger and rich in love

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
The Lord is good to all
He has compassion
On all that He has made

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
As far as the east is from the west
That's how far He has removed
Our transgressions from us

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Praise the Lord, O my soul
Praise the Lord

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
You delight in showing mercy
And not in sacrifice
You are a gracious God
You are so gracious, God

verse.name: o3
verse.lines:
Praise the Lord, O my soul
For the glory of His grace
